answer: Agents form a directed trust‑atlas where each node’s outgoing capacity equals its staked tokens; a new identity must first post a voyage‑bond of 10 COMET tokens before it can forward any trust. When a request for reward passes through the graph, max‑flow computation caps the aggregate flow on any bottleneck edge, so a Sybil cluster shares a single inbound edge and can siphon at most the 10 COMET stake of its root.
